parsed.notes:
“What Sets You Apart” does not explicitly mark its section optional; under the literal default, its technical qualifications are required. The inline academic preference applies only to fields of study.
The certification alternatives form group 1 across their concrete technology examples; explicitly named broad skills remain outside that group. RDF, OWL, and SPARQL are a separate alternative set, but all are unmapped.
MS SQL is provisionally mapped to SQL and flagged because it may specifically mean Microsoft SQL Server, which has no taxonomy entry.
Conceptual modeling is read as data modeling in this data-governance context. Data integration is not silently expanded to data pipelines.
Predictive modeling is retained as unmapped rather than assumed to mean statistical modeling; the explicit ML mention maps to machine-learning.
Seniority rests on explicit leadership duties, not on treating Manager as an enumerated senior title or on the four-year minimum.
Technologies and practices appearing only in the opportunity description or responsibilities are excluded. Academic fields, credentials themselves, and interpersonal or management skills are not technical-skill criteria.
